4.name: Box (Bullet Drop)
4.description: Floating box descending slowly. When shot 4 times, explodes into 3 enemy burst fragments.

5.name: Box (Empty)
5.description: Floating box descending slowly. Contains nothing.

6.name: Box (Power Chip)
6.description: Floating blue box descending slowly. When destroyed, drops a precious Power Chip (P)!

7.name: Umber A (Burst 7)
7.description: Squid-claw alien rising from bottom. On halting near top, bursts into 7 explosive fragments.

8.name: Umber B (Homing Pair)
8.description: Red variant rising from bottom. Bursts into 2 paired homing fragments.

9.name: Umber C (Spitter)
9.description: Cyan Umber that periodically launches lead-homing projectiles (type 20).

10.name: Duster (Meteor)
10.description: Tumbling space boulder descending while homing laterally toward the Zanac starfighter.

12.name: Teruzo (Right Corner)
12.description: Pulsing ball alien entering from bottom right, following a sweeping arc across screen.

13.name: Teruzo (Left Corner)
13.description: Pulsing ball alien entering from bottom left, sweeping in symmetric arc.

16.name: Luster (Aerial Cruiser)
16.description: Heavily armored airborne tank dropping burst charges as it traverses vertically.

17.name: Luster (Diagonal Cruiser)
17.description: Heavy fighter tracking player laterally while maintaining downward push.

18.name: Luster (Gunboat)
18.description: Orange gunboat that tracks player and fires aimed lead bullets every 48 frames.

20.name: Lead Homing
20.description: Aimed enemy projectile curving toward the player.

22.name: Veybar (Dart Glider)
22.description: Sleek dart glider diving at high speed, morphing its wings and firing a lead bullet at player.

26.name: Edge Swooper
26.description: Fast wing swooper entering from screen border, cutting diagonally and firing.

30.name: Ground Swooper (Pair)
30.description: Paired swooper locking horizontally into position before charging down.

31.name: Stealth Tracker
31.description: Twin-wing stealth jet. Matches player Y-level then flanks horizontally.

34.name: Stealth Gunship
34.description: Stationary stealth fighter firing audible 3-shot bullet spreads.

44.name: Ground Turret / Construction
44.description: Fixed ground turret on terrain. Shoots lead bullets up at the player.

56.name: Sig Missile
56.description: High-velocity missile streaking downward in fixed trajectory.

61.name: Large Descender (Mini-Boss)
61.description: Giant armored aerial craft halting halfway down the screen before diving with heavy gunfire.

63.name: Power Chip (P)
63.description: Rotating blue 'P' orb. Raises normal shot level (0..5). Every 5th chip when maxed recharges sub-weapon!

70.name: Idol Warp (Smiling / Souriant)
70.description: Idole Souriante (mt=11). A 3 tirs, degage un halo jaune pulsatile qui noirci au bout de 3s (180 frames). Consommer l'orbe une fois noirci teleporte le player vers l'Area suivante (Area 1->2). A 100 tirs, explose en cratere et accorde direct +2 vies et +10000 pts.

71.name: Idol Item (Non-Smiling / Non-souriant)
71.description: Idole Non-Souriante (mt=10). A 3 tirs, degage un halo jaune pulsatile qui reste jaune jusqu'au bout. Consommer le halo declenche un CLS ecran complet (destruction de tous les ennemis/projectiles avec sfx et flash blanc). A 100 tirs, explose en cratere et accorde direct +2 vies et +10000 pts.

72.name: Base Core (Boss Eye)
72.description: Central core of the Area Base. Opens its eye to fire bullet waves; only vulnerable while eye is open.

73.name: Base Segment
73.description: Protective armored segments surrounding the base core.

83.name: Numbered Weapon Token
83.description: Floating circular orb displaying a weapon number 0..7. Collecting it grants or recharges that sub-weapon!
